description: Shows what differs between two captured webhooks, field by field (JSON paths such as data.items[0].price), plus header differences. Use it for "this one worked and that one failed, what changed?" or to spot a provider changing its payload. Leave out `b` to compare with the previous event of the same type on the same endpoint. Changes always read from the older event to the newer one. Key order, formatting and per-delivery headers (signatures, request ids, dates) never count.

a.description: First event. Which event: its number (12 or "#12", from list_events or the dashboard), "latest", "latest <event type>" such as "latest invoice.paid", or the provider's own event id such as evt_1Qx...

b.description: Second event, same forms as `a`. Default: the previous event of the same type on the same endpoint

name: compare_events
title: Compare events
